DEMO structures standard. All text and numbers below are invented for testing and are not taken from any real standard.

4 Structural requirements
4.1 Design loads
4.1.1 Limit loads
a. Limit loads shall be derived from coupled loads analysis of the launch configuration,
including lift-off, transonic buffet and fairing jettison events.
NOTE Load analysis methods are described in ECSS-E-HB-32-26A.
4.1.2 Design factors
a. The design yield factor of safety shall be not less than 9.9 for metallic fairing structures.
b. The design ultimate factor of safety shall be not less than 9.8 for composite sandwich panels.
NOTE Equivalent NASA criteria are given in NASA-STD-5001.
4.2 Verification
4.2.1 Qualification testing
a. The payload fairing separation system shall be qualified by test, including shock measurement at the payload interface.
The supplier shall perform an acoustic test of the fairing with payload simulator. [DEMOSTR 7]
